text:
Sam (docs): heads-up — opened a docs PR to update the catalog entry for ZephyrX-8B. needs: sequence limits clarified, CPU fallback note, and a tiny SDK streaming example. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842

Priya: thanks — can you call out the recommended max input tokens for 8k vs 32k configs? we should avoid saying a single hard cap if the runtime auto-chops.

Sam (docs): good point. current bench shows stable perf up to ~9k before memory spikes on 16GB GPUs. for 32k variants we should show guidance: prefer the -long variant + KV cache enabled. I'll add numbers and a short caveat.

Marta (eng): also add a note about the quantized CPU fallback: when model gets routed to n1-quant-cpu, latency can jump x3 but it's better than OOM. small sentence in compatibility notes should do.

Lina: can we add a one-line snippet for the Python SDK with streaming + chunked prompt? a lot of customers copy-paste that. something like:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
with client.stream(model="zephyrx-8b-long") as s:
    s.send("Please summarize: " + long_text)
    for chunk in s.iter_text():
        print(chunk, end="")
```
Make sure to set `max_new_tokens` instead of `max_tokens` per the new SDK.

Sam (docs): thanks, Lina — I'll adapt that and include a note about `max_new_tokens`. Also adding a short migration bullet: `old_sdk.max_tokens -> new_sdk.max_new_tokens` in the migration guide.

Priya: one tiny ask — the PR currently links to the benchmarking spreadsheet, but the link is the private one. replace with the published summary (docs/benchmarks/zephyrx-8b-summary.md) and keep internal spreadsheet in internal notes only.

Sam (docs): done. swapped to the published summary and left an internal reference in a commented line.

Marta (eng): could you also add a brief perf table (p95 latency @ batch=1, throughput @ batch=8) — two rows is enough. ops will love the numbers.

Sam (docs): adding a 2-row table. I'll use: p95=48ms (8-bit, GPU-rtx6000), throughput=210 tok/s (@batch=8) — mark with 'approx' and date.

Lina: link-fix: the runtime compatibility doc link in the card pointed to `/compat` but should point to `/compatibility/runtime`. small path change.

Sam (docs): fixed the path. also updated tags: streaming, long-context, quant-fallback.

deploy-bot: preview build queued for PR #842 — preview URL: https://deploy-previews.redwood-inference.com/pr-842 (will be ready in ~3min) :gear:

Priya: QA checklist: 1) verify snippet runs locally with v0.12 SDK, 2) check both 8k and 32k guidance appear, 3) confirm links to runtime compatibility + benchmarks. I'll tick off after preview.

Sam (docs): assigned QA to Priya, and added a short note for release notes (docs-changelog). aim to merge after preview passes.

Marta (eng): if you want I can add the small perf numbers to the model catalog generator so the card gets auto-updated next time — ping me after this merges.

Sam (docs): appreciate it — will ping. thanks everyone :raised_hands:
